title: The female-demons lament over the death of their kith and kin
introduction: The female-demons lament over the death of their husbands and kinsfolk in battle. They further rebuke Surpanakha, for being the prime cause to bring Seetha to Lanka forcibly by Ravana and for all the combat occurring with Rama thereafter. The female-demons feel sad that Ravana did not heed to the appropriate advice given by Vibhishana. They further lament on perceiving bad omens and predict the annihilation of Ravana. They recollect an instance of celestials praying for Shiva and getting a boon that a woman (Seetha) will be born to cause the destruction of demons.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे चतुर्नवतितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 94th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तानि नागसहस्राणि सारोहाणान् च वाजिनाम् |
रथानान् चाग्निवर्णानान् सध्वजानां सहस्रशः
राक्षसानान् सहस्राणि गदापरिघयोधिनाम् |
कांचनध्वजचित्राणान् शूराणान् कामरूपिणाम्
निहतानि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तप्तकांचनभूषणैः |
रावणेन प्रयुक्तानि रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
verses.iast:
tāni nāgasahasrāṇi sārohāṇān ca vājinām |
rathānān cāgnivarṇānān sadhvajānāṃ sahasraśaḥ
rākṣasānān sahasrāṇi gadāparighayodhinām |
kāñcanadhvajacitrāṇān śUrāṇān kāmarUpiṇām
nihatāni śaraistIkṣṇaistaptakāñcanabhUṣaṇaiḥ |
rāvaṇena prayuktāni rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
verses.translation: Rama, who was unweary in action, with his shining arrows adorned with pure gold, killed those thousands of elephants dispatched by Ravana, thousands of horses, valiant demons who can change their form at will mounted on thousands of chariots with their flag-staffs, having the colour of fire, fighting with maces and iron rods and conspicuous with their golden banners.

glosses.meaning: who can change their form at will
mounted on sahasrashaH rathaanaam = thousands of chariots
and having the colour of fire
fighting with maces and iron rods
ad conspicuous with their golden banners.

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा च सम्भ्रान्ता हतशेषा निशाचराः |
राक्षस्यश्च समागम्य दीनाश्चिन्तापरिप्लुताः
विधवा हतपुत्राश्च क्रोशन्त्यो हतबान्धवाः |
राक्षस्यः सह संगम्य दुःखार्ताः पर्यदेवयन्
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca sambhrāntā hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ |
rākṣasyaśca samāgamya dInāścintāpariplutāḥ
vidhavā hataputrāśca krośantyo hatabāndhavāḥ |
rākṣasyaḥ saha saṅgamya duḥkhārtāḥ paryadevayan
verses.translation: Seeing and hearing about the killing of the demons, the surviving demons well frightened, looked sad and were overwhelmed with anxiety. They wailed when they met their wives. All female-demons who lost their husbands, sons and kinsfolk met at one place, stricken as they were with sorrow, wailed as follows:

glosses.meaning: were stricken as they were with sorrow

verses.devanagari:
कथन् शूर्पणखा वृद्धा कराला निर्णतोदरी |
आससाद वने रामन् कन्दर्पमिव रूपिणम्
verses.iast:
kathan śUrpaṇakhā vṛddhā karālā nirṇatodarI |
āsasāda vane rāman kandarpamiva rUpiṇam
verses.translation: "How did the old and ugly Surpanakha, of sunken belly, approach, in the forest, Rama who is charming like the god of love?"

glosses.meaning: who is charming like the god of love?

verses.devanagari:
सुकुमारं महासत्त्वन् सर्वभूतहिते रतम् |
तन् दृष्ट्वा लोकवध्या सा हीनरूपा प्रकामिता
verses.iast:
sukumāraṃ mahāsattvan sarvabhUtahite ratam |
tan dṛṣṭvā lokavadhyā sā hInarUpā prakāmitā
verses.translation: "How strange that on seeing that Rama of tender youth, endowed with extraordinary strength and devoted to the welfare of all created beings, that ugly woman (Surpanakha) who deserved to be condemned by the people, was stung with excessive lust?"

glosses.meaning: and devoted to the welfare of all created beings
who deserved to be condemned by people

verses.devanagari:
कथन् सर्वगुणैर्हीना गुणवन्तं महौजसं |
सुमुखन् दुर्मुखी रामं कामयामास राक्षसी
verses.iast:
kathan sarvaguṇairhInā guṇavantaṃ mahaujasaṃ |
sumukhan durmukhI rāmaṃ kāmayāmāsa rākṣasI
verses.translation: "How that ugly-faced demoness, who is bereft of all virtues, dared to make love to Rama, who is full of virtues, endowed with great bodily strength and who possessed a charming countenance?"

glosses.meaning: who is bereft of all virtues
and who possessed a beautiful face?

verses.devanagari:
जनस्यास्याल्पभाग्यत्वात्पलिनी श्वेतमूर्धजा |
अकार्यमपहास्यन् च सर्वलोकविगर्हितम्
राक्षसानान् विनाशाय दूषणस्य खरस्य च |
चकाराप्रतिरूपा सा राघवस्य प्रधर्षणम्
verses.iast:
janasyāsyālpabhāgyatvātpalinI śvetamUrdhajā |
akāryamapahāsyan ca sarvalokavigarhitam
rākṣasānān vināśāya dUṣaṇasya kharasya ca |
cakārāpratirUpā sā rāghavasya pradharṣaṇam
verses.translation: "Because of the ill-luck of these people, and to the destruction of demons and of Dushana and Khara, that grey-haired and disgusting woman, who had developed wrinkles, tried to be arrogant with Rama, misdeed which was worth ridiculing and condemned by the whole world."

glosses.meaning: and condemned by the whole world.

verses.devanagari:
तन्निमित्तमिदन् वैरं रावणेन कृतं महत् |
वधाय नीता सा सीता दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा
verses.iast:
tannimittamidan vairaṃ rāvaṇena kṛtaṃ mahat |
vadhāya nItā sā sItā daśagrIveṇa rakṣasā
verses.translation: "For the sake of that Surpanakha, Ravana built this huge enmity. For his own destruction, Ravana the demon brought that Seetha."

glosses.meaning: for the sake of that Surpanakha

verses.devanagari:
न च सीतान् दशग्रीवः प्राप्नोति जनकात्मजाम् |
बद्धं बलवता वैरमक्षयन् राघवेण ह
verses.iast:
na ca sItān daśagrIvaḥ prāpnoti janakātmajām |
baddhaṃ balavatā vairamakṣayan rāghaveṇa ha
verses.translation: "Ravana cannot obtain Seetha, the daughter of Janaka, but an endless enmity has been built with the mighty Rama."

verses.devanagari:
वैदेहीं प्रार्थयानन् तन् विराधं प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसं |
हतमेकेन रामेण पर्याप्तन् तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
vaidehIṃ prārthayānan tan virādhaṃ prekṣya rākṣasaṃ |
hatamekena rāmeṇa paryāptan tannidarśanam
verses.translation: "Seeing that instance of Rama killing single-handedly Viradha the demon, who was yearning for Seetha, is enough indeed (to convince Ravana of Rama's strength and ability)"

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम् |
निहतानि जनस्थाने शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः
verses.iast:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhImakarmaṇām |
nihatāni janasthāne śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ
verses.translation: "In Janasthana, Rama killed fourteen thousand demons who were doing terrific feats, with his arrows resembling tongues of fire."

verses.devanagari:
खरश्च निहतः संख्ये दूषणस्त्रिशिरास्तथा |
शरैरादित्यसंकाशैः पर्याप्तन् तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
kharaśca nihataḥ saṅkhye dUṣaṇastriśirāstathā |
śarairādityasaṅkāśaiḥ paryāptan tannidarśanam
verses.translation: "In that battle, Khara, Dushana and Trishira were killed with arrows resembling the sun. That instance should have been sufficient (to open the eyes of Ravana)."

verses.devanagari:
हतो योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो रुधिराशनः |
क्रोधार्तो विनदन्सोअथ पर्याप्तन् तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
hato yojanabāhuśca kabandho rudhirāśanaḥ |
krodhārto vinadansoatha paryāptan tannidarśanam
verses.translation: "Further, that Kabandha having arms with a length of eight miles each, with blood as his food and roaring with anger was killed. That instance should have been sufficient."

glosses.meaning: having arms with a length of eight miles each

verses.devanagari:
जघान बलिनन् रामः सहस्रनयनात्मजम् |
बालिनं मेघसंकाशं पर्याप्तन् तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
jaghāna balinan rāmaḥ sahasranayanātmajam |
bālinaṃ meghasaṅkāśaṃ paryāptan tannidarśanam
verses.translation: "Rama killed the mighty Vali, the son of Indra the lord of celestials, looking like the black cloud. That instance should have been sufficient. (To open the eyes of Ravana)"

glosses.meaning: the son of Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
ऋश्यमूके वसंशैले दीनो भग्नमनोरथः |
सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये पर्याप्तन् तन्निदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
ṛśyamUke vasaṃśaile dIno bhagnamanorathaḥ |
sugrIvaḥ sthāpito rājye paryāptan tannidarśanam
verses.translation: "The kingdom was restored to the miserable Sugreeva, who was residing in Mount Rishyamuka, living with his wishes disappointed. That instance should prove sufficient. (To open the eyes of Ravana)."

verses.devanagari:
धर्मार्थसहितन् वाक्यं सर्वेषां रक्षसां हितम् |
युक्तन् विभीषणेनोक्तं मोहात्तस्य न रोचते
verses.iast:
dharmārthasahitan vākyaṃ sarveṣāṃ rakṣasāṃ hitam |
yuktan vibhIṣaṇenoktaṃ mohāttasya na rocate
verses.translation: "The appropriate advice tendered by Vibhishana which was conformable to duty and interest of Ravana as also beneficial to all the demons, was not to the liking to him, due to his ignorance."

verses.devanagari:
विभीषणवचः कुर्याद्यदि स्म धनदानुजः |
श्मशानभूता दुःखार्ता नेयन् लंका पुरी भवेत्
verses.iast:
vibhIṣaṇavacaḥ kuryādyadi sma dhanadānujaḥ |
śmaśānabhUtā duḥkhārtā neyan laṅkā purI bhavet
verses.translation: "Had Ravana followed Vibhishana's advice, this Lanka would not have become a burial ground, tormented by sorrow."

verses.devanagari:
कुम्भकर्णन् हतं श्रुत्वा राघवेण महाबलम् |
अतिकायं च दुर्मर्षं लक्ष्मणेन हतं तदा
प्रियन् चेन्द्रजितं पुत्रन् रावणो नावबुध्यते |
verses.iast:
kumbhakarṇan hataṃ śrutvā rāghaveṇa mahābalam |
atikāyaṃ ca durmarṣaṃ lakṣmaṇena hataṃ tadā
priyan cendrajitaṃ putran rāvaṇo nāvabudhyate |
verses.translation: "Ravana is not able to learn a lesson, even after hearing that the mighty Kumbhakarna was killed by Rama and that unconquerable colossal-bodied Indrajit, his beloved son was killed by Lakshmana."

verses.devanagari:
मम पुत्रो मम भ्राता मम भर्ता रणे हतः
इत्येवन् श्रूयते शब्दो राक्षसानान् कुले कुले |
verses.iast:
mama putro mama bhrātā mama bhartā raṇe hataḥ
ityevan śrUyate śabdo rākṣasānān kule kule |
verses.translation: "Ravana is not able to learn a lesson, even after hearing that the mighty Kumbhakarna was killed by Rama and that the unconquerable colossal-bodied Indrajit, his beloved son was killed by Lakshmana."

verses.devanagari:
रथाश्चाश्वाश्च नागाश्च हताः शतसहस्रशः
रणे रामेण शूरेण राक्षसाश्च पदातयः |
verses.iast:
rathāścāśvāśca nāgāśca hatāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
raṇe rāmeṇa śUreṇa rākṣasāśca padātayaḥ |
verses.translation: "The valiant Rama killed hundreds and thousands of chariots, horses and elephants in the battle. He killed even the foot soldiers too."

verses.devanagari:
रुद्रो वा यदि वा विष्णुर्महेन्द्रो वा शतक्रतुः
हन्ति नो रामरूपेण यदि वा स्वयमन्तकः |
verses.iast:
rudro vā yadi vā viṣṇurmahendro vā śatakratuḥ
hanti no rāmarUpeṇa yadi vā svayamantakaḥ |
verses.translation: "Rama, coming in the form of either Rudra the lord of destruction or Vishnu, the lord of preservation, or Indra the lord of celestials who performed one hundred ritual sacrifices, or otherwise Yama, the Lord of Death himself, is killing us."

glosses.meaning: either Rudra the lord of destruction
or Indra the lord of celestials
who performed one hundred ritual sacrifices

verses.devanagari:
हतप्रवीरा रामेण निराशा जीविते वयम्
अपश्यन्त्यो भयस्यान्तमनाथा विलपामहे |
verses.iast:
hatapravIrā rāmeṇa nirāśā jIvite vayam
apaśyantyo bhayasyāntamanāthā vilapāmahe |
verses.translation: "As Rama killed all our great warriors, we are lamenting with a loss of hope in our lives, failing to see an end to our fear and having become helpless."

glosses.meaning: with our great warriors having been killed

verses.devanagari:
रामहस्ताद्दशग्रीवः शूरो दत्तवरो युधि
इदं भयं महाघोरमुत्पन्नं नावबुध्यते |
verses.iast:
rāmahastāddaśagrIvaḥ śUro dattavaro yudhi
idaṃ bhayaṃ mahāghoramutpannaṃ nāvabudhyate |
verses.translation: "The valiant Ravana, having been gifted with great boons by Brahma, is not able to understand this greatly terrific calamity, coming forth from the hand of Rama."

glosses.meaning: having been gifted with great boons

verses.devanagari:
न देवा न च गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राकसाः
उपसृष्टं परित्रातुन् शक्ता रामेण सन्युगे |
verses.iast:
na devā na ca gandharvā na piśācā na rākasāḥ
upasṛṣṭaṃ paritrātun śaktā rāmeṇa sanyuge |
verses.translation: "Neither the celestials nor Gandharvas the celestial musicians nor the evil spirits nor the demons are able to protect Ravana, who is about to attack Rama in battle."

verses.devanagari:
उत्पाताश्चापि दृश्यन्ते रावणस्य रणे रणे
कथयिष्यन्ति रामेण रावणस्य निबर्हणम् |
verses.iast:
utpātāścāpi dṛśyante rāvaṇasya raṇe raṇe
kathayiṣyanti rāmeṇa rāvaṇasya nibarhaṇam |
verses.translation: "Bad omens are appearing for Ravana, as and when his warriors are setting out for each combat. They are indeed telling about the prospective annihilation of Ravana by Rama."

verses.devanagari:
पितामहेन प्रीतेन देवदानवराक्षसैः
रावणस्याभयन् दत्तं मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम् |
verses.iast:
pitāmahena prItena devadānavarākṣasaiḥ
rāvaṇasyābhayan dattaṃ mānuṣebhyo na yācitam |
verses.translation: Brahma, the lord of creation, gratified by the austerity of Ravana, gave protection to Ravana from celestials, demons and ogres. But Ravana did not seek protection from human beings."

verses.devanagari:
तदिदं मानुषान्मन्ये प्राप्तं निःसंशयं भयम्
जीवितान्तकरन् घोरन् रक्षसां रावणस्य च |
verses.iast:
tadidaṃ mānuṣānmanye prāptaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ bhayam
jIvitāntakaran ghoran rakṣasāṃ rāvaṇasya ca |
verses.translation: "I think that such a calamity has come from that humanity only dreadfully causing an end to the lives for the demons and for Ravana too. There is no doubt about it."

glosses.meaning: which is causing an end to the lives

verses.devanagari:
पीड्यमानास्तु बलिना वरदानेन रक्षसा
दीप्तैस्तपोभिर्विबुधाः पितामहमपूजयन् |
verses.iast:
pIḍyamānāstu balinā varadānena rakṣasā
dIptaistapobhirvibudhāḥ pitāmahamapUjayan |
verses.translation: "The celestials, tormented by the mighty Ravana, because of the misuse of the boon bestowed on him, worshipped Brahma the lord of creation with their glowing austerities."

glosses.meaning: because of the bestowal of a boon on him

verses.devanagari:
देवतानान् हितार्थाय महात्मा वै पितामहः
उवाच देवताः सर्वा इदन् तुष्टो महद्वचः |
verses.iast:
devatānān hitārthāya mahātmā vai pitāmahaḥ
uvāca devatāḥ sarvā idan tuṣṭo mahadvacaḥ |
verses.translation: "The great-souled Brahma, duly gratified, spoke for the benefit of those celestials, the following words to them:

verses.devanagari:
अद्य प्रभृति लोकान्स्त्रीन्सर्वे दानवराक्षसाः
भयेन प्रावृता नित्यन् विचरिष्यन्ति शाश्वतम् |
verses.iast:
adya prabhṛti lokānstrInsarve dānavarākṣasāḥ
bhayena prāvṛtā nityan vicariṣyanti śāśvatam |
verses.translation: "From today onwards, all the ogres and demons, constantly enveloped with fear, will be wandering always in the three worlds."

verses.devanagari:
दैवतैस्तु समागम्य सर्वैश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमैः
वृषध्वजस्त्रिपुरहा महादेवः प्रसादितः |
verses.iast:
daivataistu samāgamya sarvaiścendrapurogamaiḥ
vṛṣadhvajastripurahā mahAdevaḥ prasāditaḥ |
verses.translation: "All the celestials together with Indra and others, got propitiated by Shiva the lord of destruction, with the ensign of a bull on his flag-staff and who destroyed the three strong cities built of gold, silver and iron in the sky, air and earth for demons."

glosses.meaning: by shiva the lord of dissolution
with the ensign of a bull on his flag-staff
and who destroyed the three strong cities built of gold

verses.devanagari:
प्रसन्नस्तु महादेवो देवानेतद्वचोअब्रवीत्
उत्पत्स्यति हितार्थन् वो नारी रक्षःक्षयावहा |
verses.iast:
prasannastu mahādevo devānetadvacoabravIt
utpatsyati hitārthan vo nārI rakṣaḥkṣayāvahā |
verses.translation: "The gracious Shiva spoke the following words to the celestials: 'For your benefit, a woman will be born, for causing destruction of the demons.'"

glosses.meaning: for causing destruction of the demons.

verses.devanagari:
एषा देवैः प्रयुक्ता तु क्षुद्यथा दानवान्पुरा
भक्षयिष्यति नः सीता राक्षसघ्नी सरावणान् |
verses.iast:
eṣā devaiḥ prayuktā tu kṣudyathā dānavānpurā
bhakṣayiṣyati naḥ sItā rākṣasaghnI sarāvaṇān |
verses.translation: "This Seetha, the destroyer of demons, employed by the celestials, will consume us along with Ravana, as in the past hunger consumed the demons."

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्यापनीतेन दुर्विनीतस्य दुर्मतेः
अयं निष्टानको घोरः शोकेन समभिप्लुतः |
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasyāpanItena durvinItasya durmateḥ
ayaṃ niṣṭānako ghoraḥ śokena samabhiplutaḥ |
verses.translation: "As a result of the bad behaviour of Ravana, the wicked demon with an evil disposition of mind, this terrific havoc with grief occurred."

glosses.meaning: as a result of the bad behaviour
with a bad disposition of mind

verses.devanagari:
तं न पश्यामहे लोके यो नः शरणदो भवेत्
राघवेणोपसृष्टानान् कालेनेव युगक्षये |
verses.iast:
taṃ na paśyāmahe loke yo naḥ śaraṇado bhavet
rāghaveṇopasṛṣṭānān kāleneva yugakṣaye |
verses.translation: "Rama is occupying us, as the Death occupies at the time of dissolution of the universe. We do not find any one now, who can give protection to us in this world."

glosses.meaning: at the time of dissolution of the universe

verses.devanagari:
नास्ति नः शरणं कश्चिद्भये महति तिष्ठताम्
दावाग्निवेष्ठितानां हि करेणूनां यथा वने |
verses.iast:
nāsti naḥ śaraṇaṃ kaścidbhaye mahati tiṣṭhatām
dāvāgniveṣṭhitānāṃ hi kareṇūnāṃ yathā vane |
verses.translation: "There is no refuge whatsoever for us, who stand in great danger, as indeed there is no shelter for female-elephants, enveloped by a wild fire in a forest."

glosses.meaning: as indeed (there is no shelter) for female-elephants

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्तकालं कृतं तेन पौलस्त्येन महात्मना
यत एवं भयं दृष्ठं तमेव शरणं गतः |
verses.iast:
prāptakālaṃ kṛtaṃ tena paulastyena mahātmanā
yata evaṃ bhayaṃ dṛṣṭhaṃ tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
verses.translation: "The great-souled Vibhishana did something opportune. He sought refuge in him alone from whom such a peril is perceived."

verses.devanagari:
इतीव सर्वा रजनीचरस्त्रियः |
परस्परन् सम्परिरभ्य बाहुभिः |
विषेदुरार्तातिभयाभिपीडिता |
विनेदुरुच्चैश्च तदा सुदारुणम्
verses.iast:
itIva sarvā rajanIcarastriyaḥ |
parasparan samparirabhya bāhubhiḥ |
viṣedurārtātibhayābhipIḍitā |
vineduruccaiśca tadā sudāruṇam
verses.translation: Then, all female-demons, embracing each other in their arms, afflicted as they were with grief and tormented with excessive fear, lamented thus and wept loudly and severely.

glosses.meaning: afflicted as they were with excessive fear
